author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
EDIT: Please don't comment on what the middle looks like

I went according to the poll. This is a possible replacement (unless both are wanted) for Elevated, the first Frenzy map in rotation. This is the exact same concept, but it is larger, has more cover, has less stale gameplay, and was more fun to build. I see this as a visual and game-related improvement to the original Elevated I did with {tag=0b8f95fa0f404f289fd0b8e243bb6800}

This is for the next Frenzy update.



More Images
Download (maybe?)

There are two teams like the original, Red vs. Blue.
The player cap is 16v16.
There are two spawns.
